title.zh: Critical Bitcoin Lightning bugs exposed nodes to fund theft and restart failure

current_state.zh: LDK v0.2.6 fixes critical bugs that could divert node funds via malicious splice peers and prevent saved channel state from loading after a rejected bogus payment.
